motions.method: Evaluate the original Mixamo Humanoid clip through its own Avatar with looping disabled in a temporary clone. Transfer native anatomical torso frames and limb directions to Chibi bind pose, preserving bone lengths and source axial twist. Scale pelvis balance and remove absolute/cycle travel. Adapt the oversized-head/short-arm proportions using constant chest-relative rung targets: outward and forward reach with source vertical alternation retained/scaled. Two-bone IK transports the native elbow bend plane, preserves hand LOCAL rotation, and rejects any target above98.5percent chain reach instead of per-frame reach clamps. Candidate and saved Generic curves are checked at least120Hz against actual deformed head/fist triangle crossings and containment. Support-plane gaps are diagnostic only and do not gate acceptance.
motions.retargetRevision: Rejected both manual HumanPose rest alignment and automatically built target HumanAvatar results after source stick render confirmed only3.44–8.95degree backward lean while target remained roughly25degrees. Replaced target Humanoid conversion with native-source anatomical frame/direction transfer. New render validation required. Actual triangle audits independently confirmed native right fist crossing at0.20–0.40s and left at0.5667–0.70s. Conservative26-plane scores were not reliable collision verdicts and their margin-based shoulder searches were rejected. Final proportional rung IK uses actual surface checks; final saved clip passed dense contact validation and two independent exported-triangle audits.
